meta.title: Calhoun County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Calhoun County's 2026 final budget, adopted by Appropriation Ordinance 2025-41 in November 2025. We use the single 'Budget 2026' column of the detailed budget pages. The total matches the ordinance's 'Total All County Budgets' of $7,825,631.75. The budget pages show no transfers between county funds.

nodes.name: County General
nodes.note: No fund total printed in the detailed budget; this is the sum of its departments. The ordinance (p. 2) prints a 'subtotal General Funds' of $2,906,694.15, which is $475.00 more than its own department rows; its 'County General Funds Total' ($3,544,205.40) and 'Total All County Budgets' ($7,825,631.75) use the $2,906,219.15 shown here.

nodes.name: County Park Fund
nodes.note: No fund total printed; this is the sum of its departments.

nodes.name: County Road Fund
nodes.note: The ordinance table (p. 3) shows $1,974,037.37 for County Road; the detailed budget page prints $1,974,037.89, and the ordinance's own subtotal and grand total use the $1,974,037.89 figure.

nodes.name: Solidwaste Fund
nodes.note: No fund total printed; this is the sum of its departments.
